LanguageData.WotF_Research_Adamantine.description: Fuse and recast elven steel and plasteel inside a 7×7 starlight chalk ring to forge heavy, unyielding adamantine. Unlocks ritual: rite of adamantine.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Adamantine.label: adamantine
LanguageData.WotF_Research_AltarT1.description: Construct a tier 1 wood-and-stone altar to anchor 3×3 white chalk rings and perform basic rituals. Unlocks building: wood-and-stone altar.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_AltarT1.label: wood-and-stone altar
LanguageData.WotF_Research_AltarT2.description: Build livingwood into a tier 2 altar, relying on its steadier mana-conducting grain to sustain 5×5 emerald chalk rings and tier 2 rituals. Unlocks building: livingwood altar. Unlocks crafting: staff.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_AltarT2.label: livingwood altar
LanguageData.WotF_Research_AltarT3.description: Construct a tier 3 altar around an engineering-station resonance core recovered from the depths of the ruin, capable of sustaining 7×7 starlight chalk rings and tier 3 rituals. Unlocks building: starlight altar.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_AltarT3.label: starlight altar
LanguageData.WotF_Research_ElvenSteel.description: Temper the rigidity of ordinary steel with livingwood inside a 5×5 emerald chalk ring to refine light, keen-edged elven steel. Unlocks ritual: rite of elven steel.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_ElvenSteel.label: elven steel
LanguageData.WotF_Research_GreenChalk.description: Infuse ordinary chalk with herbal medicine inside a 3×3 white chalk ring at a tier 2 altar to create the emerald chalk needed for 5×5 tier 2 rings. Unlocks ritual: rite of emerald chalk.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_GreenChalk.label: emerald chalk
LanguageData.WotF_Research_LivingWood.description: Awaken the vitality dormant in ordinary timber using herbal medicine inside a 3×3 white chalk ring, transmuting it into workable livingwood. Unlocks ritual: rite of livingwood.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_LivingWood.label: livingwood
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Mithril.description: Alloy elven steel and silver inside a 7×7 starlight chalk ring into light, spell-attuned mithril. Unlocks ritual: rite of mithril.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Mithril.label: mithril
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_BeastCall.descripti: Offer hay inside a 5×5 emerald chalk ring to summon a wild horse and attempt to tame it on the spot. Unlocks ritual: rite of beast calling.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_BeastCall.label: rite of beast calling
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_BottleMana.descript: Seal network mana into portable mana vials using wood and herbal medicine in a 3×3 white chalk ring. Unlocks ritual: rite of bottling.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_BottleMana.label: rite of bottling
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_ClearSky.descriptio: Chant an invocation inside a 5×5 emerald chalk ring to scatter heavy clouds and rain, restoring clear skies. Unlocks ritual: rite of clear skies.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_ClearSky.label: rite of clear skies
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_CounterPsychic.desc: Release a counter-pulse from a 5×5 emerald chalk ring across the entire map, cutting off hostile psychic rituals and stunning all participants. Unlocks ritual: rite of psychic severance.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_FertileSoil.descrip: Drive the vitality of a 5×5 emerald chalk ring into the earth, turning ordinary natural soil around the altar into rich soil. Unlocks ritual: rite of fertile awakening.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_FertileSoil.label: rite of fertile awakening
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_HealingGrand.descri: Advance the mending ritual to a 7×7 starlight chalk ring, regenerating missing organs and curing addictions and treatable chronic conditions. Unlocks ritual: rite of mending (starlight ring).
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_HealingGrand.label: rite of mending (starlight ring)
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_HealingMedium.descr: Channel a richer life pool in a 5×5 emerald chalk ring to smooth away old scars and regrow lost limbs. Unlocks ritual: rite of mending (emerald ring).
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_HealingMedium.label: rite of mending (emerald ring)
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_HealingMinor.descri: Channel a basic life pool in a 3×3 white chalk ring to stanch bleeding and heal fresh wounds on colonists near the altar. Unlocks ritual: rite of mending.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_HealingMinor.label: rite of mending
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_InscribeEquipment.d: Inscribe a touch, self, or orbit spell from a spellbook into a weapon or piece of armor beside the altar using a 3×3 white chalk ring, letting weapons trigger it on hit and armor trigger it when struck. Unlocks ritual: rite of spell inscribing.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_LeylineMining.descr: Reach into deep rock veins with a 7×7 starlight chalk ring to draw mineral deposits directly from beneath the altar without a drill. Unlocks ritual: rite of leyline mining.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_LeylineMining.label: rite of leyline mining

WotF_Research_Ritual_ManaSpring.customUn.li: Ritual: rite of the mana spring

LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_ManaSpring.descript: Channel network mana through a 3×3 white chalk ring to replenish mana for nearby forest-blooded colonists. Unlocks ritual: rite of the mana spring.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_ManaSpring.label: rite of the mana spring
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_RainCall.descriptio: Call a gentle rain over the settlement with a 5×5 emerald chalk ring to water fields and douse spreading fires. Unlocks ritual: rite of rain.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_RainCall.label: rite of rain
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_RuneAwakening.descr: Perform awakening rites in the matching chalk ring for each rune tier to gradually unlock new spell runes for the colony. Unlocks ritual: rite of rune awakening.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_RuneAwakening.label: rite of rune awakening
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_SeekRuin.descriptio: Tap into the remnants of the psychic network through a 5×5 emerald chalk ring to locate a dormant ancient engineering ruin on the world map and recover relics and resonance cores. Unlocks ritual: rite of seeking.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_SeekRuin.label: rite of seeking

WotF_Research_Ritual_ShieldDome.customUn.li: Ritual: rite of the grove shield

LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_ShieldDome.descript: Awaken the altar's ward in a 5×5 emerald chalk ring to raise a one-way grove shield dome over the settlement that blocks hostile fire while letting friendly shots pass. Unlocks ritual: rite of the grove shield.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_ShieldDome.label: rite of the grove shield
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_SkyWrath.descriptio: Sustain a channeling rite inside a 7×7 starlight chalk ring to call down repeated lightning strikes onto unroofed enemies nearby. Unlocks ritual: rite of sky wrath.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_SkyWrath.label: rite of sky wrath
Awaken a dormant apprentice spellbook in a 3×3 white chalk ring so a forest-blooded colonist can wear it and cast spells. Unlocks ritual: rite of spellbook awakening.

WotF_Research_Ritual_SpellbookUpgradeAde.li: Ritual: rite of the adept spellbook

LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_SpellbookUpgradeAde: Upgrade an apprentice spellbook with elven steel and jade inside a 5×5 emerald chalk ring into an adept spellbook, expanding the rune chain limit to 7 runes per spell. Unlocks ritual: rite of the adept spellbook.

WotF_Research_Ritual_SpellbookUpgradeArc.li: Ritual: rite of the starlight codex

LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_SpellbookUpgradeArc: Reforge an adept spellbook with mithril and starlight chalk inside a 7×7 starlight chalk ring into a starlight codex, raising the rune chain limit to 10 runes per spell and enabling supra runes. Unlocks ritual: rite of the starlight codex.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_Teleport.descriptio: Align spatial coordinates through a 5×5 emerald chalk ring to transport colonists near the altar directly to an active teleport gate on the same map. Unlocks ritual: local teleport.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_Teleport.label: local teleport
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_Thunderstorm.descri: Summon a storm through a 7×7 starlight chalk ring, sweeping the entire map with lightning and torrential rain. Unlocks ritual: rite of thunderstorm.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_Ritual_Thunderstorm.label: rite of thunderstorm
A curious transmutation formula in a 5×5 emerald chalk ring that reshapes steel and herbal medicine directly into industrial components. Unlocks ritual: rite of components.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_StarChalk.description: Fuse white chalk with silver and jade inside a 5×5 emerald chalk ring to produce starlight chalk for drawing 7×7 tier-3 chalk rings. Unlocks ritual: rite of starlight chalk.
LanguageData.WotF_Research_StarChalk.label: starlight chalk
